_note: Which shell each page renders. full = announcement bar, header with the category row, footer, mobile tab bar, menu drawer, cart drawer, quick-add sheet. checkout = header-minimal + footer-minimal (fewer exits at payment). error = header-error + footer-minimal (the 500 and 503 views cannot rely on the database or session). none = no shell (the prototype stand-in for the payment gateway). tools/check-shell.mjs checks every page against this file; add a new page here.
_footerFrom: Optional, full-shell pages only: "white" or "secondary" = the full-bleed colour of the last section, which the footer gradient then starts from (sync-shell writes <body data-footer-from>). No entry = the page background. tools/check-footer-seam.mjs lists every seam.
